   142	def parse_config(c, C):
   143	    need_obj(c, CFG_KEYS)
   144	    S = need_int(c["slots"], 1, 256)
   145	    W = need_int(c["window"], 1, 16)
   146	    idle = need_int(c["idle_timeout"], 1, 10 ** 12)
   147	    lq = need_int(c["len_quantum"], 1, 65535)
   148	    gq = need_int(c["gap_quantum"], 1, 65535)
   149	    rn = need_int(c["rate_num"], 1, 10 ** 6)
   150	    rd = need_int(c["rate_den"], 1, 10 ** 6)
   151	    bcap = need_int(c["bucket_capacity"], 1, 512)
   152	    itok = need_int(c["initial_tokens"], 0, bcap)
   153	    pcap = need_int(c["pending_capacity"], 1, 512)
   154	    L = need_int(c["lanes"], 1, 4)
   155	    svc = need_list(c["service"], C)
   156	    for v in svc:
   157	        need_int(v, 1, 10 ** 6)
   158	    fb = need_int(c["fallback"], 0, C - 1)
   159	    te = need_list(c["time_edges"], lo=1, hi=16)
   160	    prev = None
   161	    for v in te:
   162	        need_int(v, 0, 10 ** 12)
   163	        if prev is None:
   164	            if v != 0:
   165	                raise Invalid("time_edges must start at 0")
   166	        elif v <= prev:
   167	            raise Invalid("time_edges must strictly increase")
   168	        prev = v
   169	    ce = need_list(c["count_edges"], lo=1, hi=16)
   170	    prev = None
   171	    for v in ce:
   172	        need_int(v, 0, 20000)
   173	        if prev is None:
   174	            if v != 0:
   175	                raise Invalid("count_edges must start at 0")
   176	        elif v <= prev:
   177	            raise Invalid("count_edges must strictly increase")
   178	        prev = v
   179	    nt = len(te)
   180	    nc = len(ce)
   181	    prob = need_list(c["probability"], nt)
   182	    for row in prob:
   183	        need_list(row, nc)
   184	        for v in row:
   185	            need_int(v, 0, 65536)
   186	    return (S, W, idle, lq, gq, rn, rd, bcap, itok, pcap, L,
   187	            svc, fb, te, ce, prob)

   190	def parse_connections(raw, S, C):
   191	    conns = need_list(raw, hi=2048)
   192	    n = len(conns)
   193	    index = {}
   194	    ids = [None] * n
   195	    slots = [0] * n
   196	    labels = [0] * n
   197	    splits = [None] * n
   198	    for i, cn in enumerate(conns):
   199	        need_obj(cn, CONN_KEYS)
   200	        cid = need_str(cn["id"])
   201	        if not ID_RE.match(cid):
   202	            raise Invalid("bad connection id")
   203	        if cid in index:
   204	            raise Invalid("duplicate connection id")
   205	        index[cid] = i
   206	        ids[i] = cid
   207	        slots[i] = need_int(cn["slot"], 0, S - 1)
   208	        labels[i] = need_int(cn["label"], 0, C - 1)
   209	        sp = need_str(cn["split"])
   210	        if sp != "dev" and sp != "eval":
   211	            raise Invalid("bad split")
   212	        splits[i] = sp
   213	    return index, ids, slots, labels, splits

   216	def parse_packets(raw, index):
   217	    pkts = need_list(raw, hi=20000)
   218	    out = []
   219	    ap = out.append
   220	    get = index.get
   221	    last_t = -1
   222	    for p in pkts:
   223	        need_obj(p, PKT_KEYS)
   224	        t = need_int(p["time"], 0, 10 ** 12)
   225	        if t < last_t:
   226	            raise Invalid("packet times decrease")
   227	        last_t = t
   228	        ci = get(need_str(p["connection"]))
   229	        if ci is None:
   230	            raise Invalid("unknown connection")
   231	        ln = need_int(p["length"], 0, 65535)
   232	        dr = need_int(p["draw"], 0, 65535)
   233	        ap((t, ci, ln, dr))
   234	    return out

   241	def build_conv_tables(lemb, gemb, cw, K, F):
   242	    """g[f][k][code] = dot(conv_weights[f][k], embed(code))."""
   243	    xs = []
   244	    ap = xs.append
   245	    for a in range(16):
   246	        la = lemb[a]
   247	        for b in range(16):
   248	            ap(la + gemb[b])
   249	    g = []
   250	    for f in range(F):
   251	        tabs = []
   252	        for k in range(K):
   253	            w = cw[f][k]
   254	            tabs.append([sum(map(mul, w, x)) for x in xs])
   255	        g.append(tabs)
   256	    return g

   259	def replay(cfg, model, conn_info, packets):
   260	    (C, E, K, F, lemb, gemb, cw, cb, cs, dw, db) = model
   261	    (S, W, idle, lq, gq, rn, rd, bcap, itok, pcap, L, svc, fb, te, ce, prob) = cfg
   262	    index, cids, cslots, clabels, csplits = conn_info
   263	    nconn = len(cids)
   264	
   265	    g = build_conv_tables(lemb, gemb, cw, K, F)
   266	    nstarts = W - K + 1
   267	    memo = {}
   268	
   269	    def cnn(codes):
   270	        """codes: bytes of quantized row codes, len == W. Returns (logits, pred)."""
   271	        hit = memo.get(codes)
   272	        if hit is not None:
   273	            return hit
   274	        pooled = []
   275	        pap = pooled.append
   276	        for f in range(F):
   277	            tabs = g[f]
   278	            acc = None
   279	            for k in range(K):
   280	                seq = list(map(tabs[k].__getitem__, codes[k:k + nstarts]))
   281	                acc = seq if acc is None else list(map(add, acc, seq))
   282	            z = cb[f] + max(acc)
   283	            sh = cs[f]
   284	            if sh:
   285	                half = 1 << (sh - 1)
   286	                if z >= 0:
   287	                    z = (z + half) >> sh
   288	                else:
   289	                    z = -(((-z) + half) >> sh)
   290	            if z < 0:
   291	                z = 0
   292	            elif z > 127:
   293	                z = 127
   294	            pap(z)
   295	        logits = [db[c] + sum(map(mul, dw[c], pooled)) for c in range(C)]
   296	        res = (logits, logits.index(max(logits)))
   297	        memo[codes] = res
   298	        return res
